div.head: II As 1.5
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hwa hine forstande, forgylde hine be his were, swa ðam cynge swa ðam ðe hit togebyrige; ⁊ ælc man ðara ðe ðær midstande gesylle hundtwelftig scill' to wite ðam cynge.
⁊ gif hine hwa forstonde, forgilde hine be his were, swa þam cyninge swa ðam ðe hit mid ryhte togebyrige; ⁊ ælc man ðara ðe þær midstande gesylle ðam cyninge CXX scll' to wite.
Ond gif hine hwa foran forstande, forgylde hine be his were, swa ðæm cyning swa þæm þe hit togebyrige; ⁊ ælc þara þe þær midstande geselle CXX scill' to wite þam cyninge.
Et si quis obstabit, persoluat se wera sua, sic regi sic ei, cui pertinet (cuius rectum erit); et omnis, qui cum eo stabit (coadiuuabit), emendet CXX sol. wyte regi.
⁊ gif hine hwa forstonde, forgilde hine be his were, swa þam cyninge swa ðam ðe hit mid ryhte togebyrige; ⁊ ælc man ðara ðe þær midstande gesylle ðam cyninge CXX scll' to wite.

If anyone defends him, he shall pay for him to the amount of his wergeld either to the king or to him to whom it is legally due, and everyone who renders him assistance shall pay a fine of 120 shillings to the king.

Und wenn jemand (vorweg So) für ihn [hiergegen] eintritt, so bezahle er ihn durch dessen Wergeld entweder dem König oder wem es gesetzlich zusteht; und jedermann, welcher da [zur Widersetzlichkeit] beisteht, gebe dem König 120 Schilling als Strafgeld.

And if anyone (beforehand, So) intervenes for him [against this], let him pay for him with his wergild either to the king or to whomever it lawfully belongs; and everyone who stands by [in the resistance] there is to give the king 120 shillings as a fine.
